summary: Mitesco, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing that holders of over 54% of its Series X Preferred approved amending the Certificate of Designation to raise authorized shares from 500 million to 1 billion, with board approval and a forthcoming information statement. Separately, the board issued 4,800 additional Series X Preferred shares each to directors Leath, Valania and Panunto, and to Anglo Irish Management, bringing outstanding Series X to 91,103 shares. Roughly 60 million common shares are outstanding, about 20 million in float. No transaction pricing or special-situation event is stated; watch for dilution and disclosure mechanics.
